product.title: Half-Day Hill Country Wine Shuttle From Austin

description.text: Travel southwest of Austin into the Driftwood and Wimberley Hill Country in a Mercedes Sprinter with a local guide. Sample wines at three award-winning wineries across a 4.5-hour afternoon shuttle limited to about 10 guests. Stops include Austin Departure, Duchman Family Winery, Wimberley Valley Winery, Limestone Terrace Vineyard. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on Austin skyline views, lake corridors, and Hill Country highlights. Ideal for visitors basing in Austin who want a guided Capital City experience without coordinating meeting points, trailheads, or photo locations on their own.
